JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Digna, Flora, Janie, Sumiko

payload.content: Planning message from Sumiko: I am available for tasks requiring up to 4 hours. I have strong skills in api-development and testing, which reduces my cost for tasks tagged with these skills. I prefer to take on a critical priority task if feasible. Given my availability and cost, I am inclined toward ISSUE-0001::triage as it fits my availability and is critical priority with the lowest cost among critical tasks I can handle. I welcome other agents to coordinate to avoid duplication, especially for critical tasks.

To all: I am assessing critical tasks ISSUE-0001 related to devops and api-development. I am considering review or triage tasks that fit within 4 hours availability and have moderate cost. Let's avoid duplication to maximize task coverage. Please share your preferences.

I am considering critical tasks on ISSUE-0001 related to testing or triage, as well as medium priority tasks on ISSUE-0002 if they are a good fit. I would like to coordinate to avoid overlaps and maximize task completion. Please share your preferred tasks or thoughts.

I see Sumiko is inclined to take triage on ISSUE-0001, which fits her availability and skills well. Flora looks at review or triage too. I aim to avoid duplication and can cover testing on ISSUE-0001 or medium priority tasks on ISSUE-0002 if others prefer critical tasks.

I am considering ISSUE-0001::triage or docs which fit my skills and availability well. I hope others will coordinate to avoid overlap on critical tasks. I see Flora prefers review on this critical task. Let's aim for maximum task coverage.

Sumiko confirms preference for ISSUE-0001::triage for critical priority and fits her availability and skills. Suggests Flora consider review to avoid duplication, Digna to consider testing or medium priority tasks on ISSUE-0002, and Janie to consider docs or other non-triage critical tasks. Let's coordinate for maximum task coverage without overlap.

To all: We see critical tasks ISSUE-0001 are in demand. Flora is leaning toward review, while Janie aims at triage or docs. Sumiko, Digna, please consider other critical or medium priority ISSUE-0002 tasks to avoid duplication and maximize task coverage. Let's coordinate closely to avoid overlap and maximize our team efficiency. Please share your preferences and availability constraints.

To all: I acknowledge Sumiko's choice of ISSUE-0001::triage and Flora's leaning towards ISSUE-0001::review. Janie has interest in triage or docs. With my 10 hours availability and strong skills in testing and api-development, I am inclined to take ISSUE-0001::test or one of the medium priority ISSUE-0002 tasks to help maximize task coverage. I prefer ISSUE-0001::test for its critical priority if it does not conflict with others' plans. Otherwise, I can cover ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test. Please confirm your final preferences so we can avoid duplication and optimize our picks.

Reminder to all: Let's finalize our preferred tasks soon. I am leaning towards ISSUE-0001::test given my skills and availability, but can switch to medium priority ISSUE-0002 tasks if needed to avoid overlap. Please share your final task preferences or any changes to your availability or skills that might affect your choices.

To all: I see Flora is leaning towards ISSUE-0001::review and I am considering ISSUE-0001::docs as my preferred critical task. This helps us avoid overlaps and maximize coverage. Others, please confirm your preferred tasks soon to finalize planning.
To all: Let's finalize plans soon. I am leaning towards ISSUE-0001::docs to complement Flora's review choice. Others, please share final task choices to avoid overlap and maximize task completion.
